marta: Hey team — quick heads up, I ran the scheduled svcacct owner scan. Found ~120 service accounts with keys older than 180 days and ~28 ownerless keys tied to KMS-encrypted secrets.
jamal: yikes. do we have a public runbook for rotating+removing those?
alex: we have a draft in docs but not automated. I can sketch a small script:
alex: ```bash
# list keys with age >180d
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=SA_EMAIL --format=json | jq -r '.[] | select(.validAfterTime < "2023-01-01T00:00:00Z")'
```
sophia: FYI some of those keys are referenced in legacy CI jobs in gitlab-ci, need to avoid breaking deploys.
marta: good point. plan proposal: 1) create CSV of affected SAs + key IDs + lastUsed (audit logs) 2) open owner review ticket to confirm owner or replace 3) schedule rotation window with app teams 4) revoke orphan keys after 7 days no-owner grace.
jamal: can we leverage KMS audit logs to map which keys decrypt happen recently? That helps decide critical vs stale.
auditbot: audit-log-query: found 64 KMS decrypt events in last 90 days for the implicated key set. Run id: 20240622-01.
sophia: please include link to the audit export — I'm on call for infra this week, can triage any immediate deploy hits.
marta: putting a short checklist in the ticket: CSV, sample commands, rollback steps, contact list. Also flag any keys with recent decrypts as DO_NOT_REVOKE until team confirms.
ajam: @jamal (actually typo), jamal: I'll take the automation piece — can create a job that posts to a PR with owners detected via OWNERS files and a second pass for manual owner assignment. ETA EOW.
jamal: great — can you also include an allowlist for CI roles that need special handling?
ajam: yes. script will produce three outputs: stale.csv, recent-decrypts.csv, and owner-suggestions.json.
sophia: for safety, let's add a staged revoke: 1) set key to disabled (if supported), 2) wait 48h, 3) delete. avoids sudden outages.
marta: agree. also add a KMS label `pending-revoke=YYYYMMDD` so dashboards pick it up.
security-oncall: Reminder: change freezes next Tue; aim to complete rotation windows before then or schedule exceptions.
jamal: schedule note — I'll ping product teams that own the top-10 apps using these SAs.
alex: I'll draft the ticket in JIRA: INFSEC-4219. It will include the CSV attachment and links to the automation PR.
marta: thanks. action items: jamal -> owner outreach; alex -> ticket + script PR; ajam -> automation job; sophia -> CI safe list + watch window. target: revoke phase starts 2024-07-05.
auditbot: export created: gs://redwood-audit-exports/svcacct-scan/1736004321/export-20240622.csv
marta: perfect. if anyone sees a blocker post here, otherwise I'll mark kickoff and assign owners by EOD tomorrow. :wave:
